description: Defines the PageSetup class for configuring page layout and formatting in the MigraDoc document object model, including properties for page size, orientation, margins, and serialization.

classes.name: PageSetup
classes.description: Represents the page setup configuration for a section, including size, margins, orientation, and other layout properties.

classes.name: PageSetup.PageSetupValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for PageSetup, used for serialization and default value management.

methods.name: GetPageSize
methods.description: Calculates and outputs the page width and height in units based on the specified PageFormat.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the PageSetup instance.

methods.name: Freeze
methods.description: Freezes the PageSetup instance to prevent further modifications.

methods.name: ResetPageSize
methods.description: Resets page size and format properties to default or null values.

methods.name: PreviousPageSetup
methods.description: Retrieves the PageSetup of the previous section if available.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the PageSetup object into a DDL format.
